verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents its own Batch Processing API for high-volume processing, plus asynchronous screening for high-volume scenarios and date-range bulk exports across several record types. Evidence for bulk operations beyond screening and export is thin: monitoring status and configuration endpoints are explicitly scoped to a single customer, and nothing shows bulk case or alert remediation. Missing for 10: detailed Batch Processing API documentation (supported operations, limits), bulk monitor/unmonitor, bulk case and alert decisions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
